title: The three companion-vs-companion 'draw' checks (barrow doors, drowned font buckle, chandler's ring) all use nearly identical framing and all three times resolved cleanly with no regard cost on a success, but nothing in the room text warns whether a miss would have cost both companions equally or unequally, so the stakes of attempting the draw were never made concrete before rolling.
where: The Empty Seat / talking with Brother Osk -- call the door's fate a draw; The Drowned Font / talking with Vell -- tell them it's not yours to grade; The Old Court, at Rest / talking with Tamsin -- tell them it's not yours to price
